note: Re-judged 2026-09-30: the units changed only by dropping the retired RFC1350-5-2 tag comments; every assertion is unchanged. Forbidden: DATA block 2 before block 1 is ACKed. TestRFC1350LockstepWaitsForTheACK requires block 1 to be exactly octets 0..511, then expectSilence for 1 s with block 1 unacked (red on a server that streams ahead; the ACK timeout is 5 s so no retransmission confounds it), then after ACK 1 block 2 must be octets 512..1023. Both clauses (one block per packet, ACK before the next) are asserted in both polarities. The older handler_test units stay weak on their own.
